title: Weekly Recap
message:
This week was pure momentum. We tightened the roster to **42 active**, kept the engine running with **460 donations**, and then slammed the door on the River Race finale with a clean statement: **Season 130, Week 5 — 1st place**. Not “we survived,” not “we scraped by.” We *finished* — and we took **+100 war trophies** with it.

The war story has three names written all over it: **TR**, **Ｓｈａｆｉｔｈ Ｎｉｈａｌ♥️**, and **raquaza**. TR and Shafith both dropped **2,750 fame** with **16/16 decks** each — perfect volume, no excuses, full pressure. Raquaza answered with **2,600 fame** on **16/16**. That’s the kind of end-of-season reliability that turns “a good clan” into a clan that climbs. And the result wasn’t ambiguous: **23,050 fame** and the race was ours.

Outside war, the ladder and progression pulse was loud. **Ditaka hit 10,000** — that’s a real line to cross, and it matters. **xXAngelXx** made the biggest leap, up **+826 trophies** to **4,749**, with **+70 wins** behind it. **feen** cracked **6,001** with **+471**, **TR** climbed **+635**, and **gooba** pushed **+549** while stacking **+144 career wins** in the same week. That’s not random variance — that’s people building accounts with intent.

I’m also clocking the fight streak energy: **MONICA** came in and immediately lit a match, going **10 straight wins**. **1spaceO2** and **Domis_OP** both held strong form too (6 and 5 straight respectively). And on the culture side, donations are staying healthy — **Shafith (43)**, **Chanco (42)**, **L-Drxgo⚡ (38)**, **raquaza (38)**, **King Levy (36)** leading the flow. That’s how a young clan stops feeling young.

We’re rolling into **Season 131** with **8 open slots** and a real upward war trend already on the books. Same standard as always: when battle days are live, we empty decks; when it’s prep, we get set early. Next week, I want this momentum to feel routine — not rare.
